title: Conditional late expiratory emptying does not establish improved bronchodilator-response prediction
abstract: In exploratory transfer from NHANES 2007–2008 (n=349) to 2011–2012 (n=261), adding conditional late-emptying fraction to flexible standard spirometry reduced weighted bronchodilator FEV1-response MSE by 122.94 mL² (0.57%), but joint source/target PSU-bootstrap uncertainty spanned harm (added-minus-baseline MSE 95% interval −2102.71 to 5033.57 mL²). Incremental predictive usefulness was not established.
